svg.title: Flyper Wolf architecture
svg.desc: At inference, a simulated scene and camera produce a 384 by 384 rendered view. Grayscale pooling samples 721 receptors, feeding a frozen FlyVis circuit whose activity evolves. The learned fw-est342 estimator reads circuit activity and predicts the target direction in camera coordinates: right, forward, and up. The fw-cont24 proportional controller, with gain 24, turns the camera in yaw and pitch. The resulting view closes the loop at 100 hertz. In a separate offline supervised learning process, recorded circuit activity and true camera-local direction labels train only the estimator. The fitted estimator weights enter the estimator, not the visual circuit or controller. Simulator geometry supplies training labels and evaluation score outside inference.

g.text: Simulator geometry supplies training labels and evaluation score, outside the inference path.
